text:
Nothing in `run-events.spec.md` or in the code names `usage_limit` on the `agent_run` record yet. The spec has a place where the keys would go, and the code has the one line that writes them.

- **Spec:** `plugins/tempergraph/docs/specs/run-events.spec.md` has no `usage_limit` or `usage_limit_resets_at`. I searched for `usage_limit` there, and the earlier grep for `usage_limit|reset_at|resets_at` over `plugins/tempergraph` found no hit in this file.
- **Where it would go:** `agent_run` is named only in line 65, EVT-B16 "Keys added to existing records". That sentence adds to `agent_run` `duration_s`, `tool_wall_share` and `slow_host`, and its one scenario covers `gate` and `judgement_seq`. EVT-B16 is the owner for new keys on an existing record.
- **Input already stated:** SSN-B11 in `session-contract.spec.md` (lines 88-92) and SSN-AC8 (line 103) define `usage_limit` as bool and `usage_limit_resets_at` as an instant or null. ECC-B17 in `executor-claude-code.spec.md` (lines 93-97) says the Claude executor reads the reset as epoch seconds from `resetsAt`. It is null when `resetsAt` is absent or `errorCode` is `credits_required`.
- **Code:** `engine/src/tempergraph/run/nodes.py:371-382` writes `agent_run` with `usage`, `ok`, `infra_cause`, `error_kind`, `timed_out`, `stalled`, `duration_s`, `tool_wall_share` and `slow_host`. It does not write `usage_limit` or `usage_limit_resets_at`. This is the only `agent_run` writer I found under `run/`, and I read this line range.
- **Result fields:** `SessionResult` has both fields at `contracts.py:717-718`. `executors/session.py:88-98` sets them only when the session is not ok. `usage_limit` is read only in `contracts.py`, `executors/` and `improve/`, never in `run/`.
- **Different record name:** the review loop's `review_failed` record carries `error_class` `usage_limit` and `resets_at` (`session-review.spec.md` lines 117-128; `improve/review.py:652-656`). That is a separate record with its own key names, not the run log's `agent_run`.

ARTIFACT gap_finding: run-events.spec.md has no `usage_limit`/`usage_limit_resets_at`; `agent_run` appears only in EVT-B16 (line 65), which adds `duration_s`, `tool_wall_share` and `slow_host` to `agent_run`, so EVT-B16 is the spec place for the new keys. Code: run/nodes.py:371-382 is the only `agent_run` writer under run/ and writes `usage`, `ok`, `infra_cause`, `error_kind`, `timed_out`, `stalled`, `duration_s`, `tool_wall_share`, `slow_host`, not `usage_limit` (read). `SessionResult` has `usage_limit` and `usage_limit_resets_at` (contracts.py:717-718, float|None epoch; executors/session.py:88-98 sets them only when not ok), so the writer has the values. Input is stated in session-contract.spec.md SSN-B11 (88-92) and SSN-AC8 (103), and executor-claude-code.spec.md ECC-B17 (93-97, `resetsAt` as epoch seconds, null for `credits_required`). `review_failed` in session-review.spec.md 117-128 and improve/review.py:652-656 uses `error_class` and `resets_at`, a separate record.
